# egfr

**egfr** is a vectorised R toolkit for estimating glomerular filtration
rate (eGFR) and creatinine clearance from serum creatinine, cystatin C,
or both. It implements 20 validated adult, paediatric, and neonatal
equations, plus helpers for body surface area, KDIGO CKD staging, and
unit conversion.

The package is inspired by the
[`kidney.epi`](https://cran.r-project.org/package=kidney.epi) package
and was ported from the equation set used by
[eGFR.app](https://github.com/mhovd/egfr-app).

> These equations are screening tools and are **not** a substitute for
> measured GFR or clinical judgement.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("mhovd/egfr")
```

## Quick start

``` r

library(egfr)

# CKD-EPI 2021 creatinine (race-free) — recommended for adults
egfr_ckdepi_cr_2021(creatinine = 1.0, age = 50, sex = "female")
#> 68.6

# Fully vectorised: pass vectors for any argument
egfr_ckdepi_cr_2021(
  creatinine = c(0.8, 1.2, 1.5),
  age        = c(40, 65, 72),
  sex        = c("female", "male", "female")
)

# Units: supply creatinine in umol/L instead of mg/dL
egfr_ckdepi_cr_2021(88.4, 50, "female", creatinine_units = "umol/l")

# Classify the result into a KDIGO stage
ckd_stage(egfr_ckdepi_cr_2021(1.0, 50, "female"))
#> "G2"
```

## Available equations

### Adult

| Function | Equation | Biomarker |
|----|----|----|
| [`egfr_ckdepi_cr_2021()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ckdepi_cr_2021.md) | CKD-EPI 2021 (race-free) | creatinine |
| [`egfr_ckdepi_cys_2021()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ckdepi_cys_2021.md) | CKD-EPI 2021 (race-free) | cystatin C |
| [`egfr_ckdepi_cr_cys_2021()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ckdepi_cr_cys_2021.md) | CKD-EPI 2021 (race-free) | both |
| [`egfr_ckdepi_cr_2009()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ckdepi_cr_2009.md) | CKD-EPI 2009 (with race) | creatinine |
| [`egfr_ckdepi_cys_2012()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ckdepi_cys_2012.md) | CKD-EPI 2012 | cystatin C |
| [`egfr_mdrd()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_mdrd.md) | MDRD 4-variable (IDMS) | creatinine |
| [`egfr_cockcroft_gault()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_cockcroft_gault.md) | Cockcroft-Gault (CrCl) | creatinine |
| [`egfr_ekfc_cr()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ekfc_cr.md) | EKFC 2021 | creatinine |
| [`egfr_ekfc_cys()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ekfc_cys.md) | EKFC 2023 | cystatin C |
| [`egfr_ekfc_cr_cys()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ekfc_cr_cys.md) | EKFC 2023 | both |
| [`egfr_fas_cr()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_fas_cr.md) | Full Age Spectrum 2016 | creatinine |
| [`egfr_lund_malmo()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_lund_malmo.md) | Lund-Malmoe Revised 2011 | creatinine |
| [`egfr_bis_cr()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_bis_cr.md) | Berlin Initiative Study 2012 | creatinine |

### Paediatric & neonatal

| Function | Equation | Biomarker |
|----|----|----|
| [`egfr_schwartz()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_schwartz.md) | Schwartz bedside 2009 | creatinine |
| [`egfr_ckid_u25_cr()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ckid_u25_cr.md) | CKiD U25 2021 | creatinine |
| [`egfr_ckid_u25_cys()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ckid_u25_cys.md) | CKiD U25 2021 | cystatin C |
| [`egfr_ckid_u25_cr_cys()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ckid_u25_cr_cys.md) | CKiD U25 2021 | both |
| [`egfr_ckid_u25_cr_extended()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ckid_u25_cr_extended.md) | CKiD U25 extended (to 30) | creatinine |
| [`egfr_capa()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_capa.md) | CAPA 2014 | cystatin C |
| [`egfr_neonatal()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_neonatal.md) | Neonatal 2022 | creatinine |

### Helpers

| Function | Purpose |
|----|----|
| [`bsa()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/bsa.md) | Body surface area (Du Bois, Haycock, Mosteller) |
| [`gfr_bsa_adjust()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/gfr_bsa_adjust.md) | Convert between absolute and BSA-normalised GFR |
| [`ckd_stage()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/ckd_stage.md) | KDIGO GFR category (G1-G5) |
| [`convert_creatinine()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/convert_creatinine.md) | mg/dL \<-\> umol/L |

## Conventions

- All `egfr_*()` functions return **unrounded** values in
  mL/min/1.73m^2, except
  [`egfr_cockcroft_gault()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_cockcroft_gault.md),
  which returns creatinine clearance in mL/min.
- Creatinine defaults to **mg/dL**; pass `creatinine_units = "umol/l"`
  to use SI units. Height defaults to **cm**.
- Sex labels default to `"male"`/`"female"` and can be customised via
  `label_sex_male` / `label_sex_female`.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`bsa()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/bsa.md) : Body
  surface area (BSA)
- [`ckd_stage()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/ckd_stage.md) :
  KDIGO CKD stage from eGFR
- [`convert_creatinine()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/convert_creatinine.md)
  : Convert serum creatinine between mg/dL and umol/L
- [`egfr_bis_cr()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_bis_cr.md)
  : Berlin Initiative Study (BIS1) creatinine eGFR (2012)
- [`egfr_capa()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_capa.md) :
  CAPA paediatric cystatin C eGFR (2014)
- [`egfr_ckdepi_cr_2009()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ckdepi_cr_2009.md)
  : CKD-EPI 2009 creatinine eGFR (with race coefficient)
- [`egfr_ckdepi_cr_2021()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ckdepi_cr_2021.md)
  : CKD-EPI 2021 creatinine eGFR (race-free)
- [`egfr_ckdepi_cr_cys_2021()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ckdepi_cr_cys_2021.md)
  : CKD-EPI 2021 combined creatinine + cystatin C eGFR (race-free)
- [`egfr_ckdepi_cys_2012()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ckdepi_cys_2012.md)
  : CKD-EPI 2012 cystatin C eGFR
- [`egfr_ckdepi_cys_2021()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ckdepi_cys_2021.md)
  : CKD-EPI 2021 cystatin C eGFR (race-free)
- [`egfr_ckid_u25_cr()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ckid_u25_cr.md)
  : CKiD U25 creatinine eGFR
- [`egfr_ckid_u25_cr_cys()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ckid_u25_cr_cys.md)
  : CKiD U25 combined creatinine + cystatin C eGFR
- [`egfr_ckid_u25_cr_extended()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ckid_u25_cr_extended.md)
  : CKiD U25 extended creatinine eGFR (to age 30)
- [`egfr_ckid_u25_cys()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ckid_u25_cys.md)
  : CKiD U25 cystatin C eGFR
- [`egfr_cockcroft_gault()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_cockcroft_gault.md)
  : Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance
- [`egfr_ekfc_cr()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ekfc_cr.md)
  : EKFC creatinine eGFR (2021)
- [`egfr_ekfc_cr_cys()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ekfc_cr_cys.md)
  : EKFC combined creatinine + cystatin C eGFR (2023)
- [`egfr_ekfc_cys()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_ekfc_cys.md)
  : EKFC cystatin C eGFR (2023)
- [`egfr_fas_cr()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_fas_cr.md)
  : Full Age Spectrum (FAS) creatinine eGFR
- [`egfr_lund_malmo()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_lund_malmo.md)
  : Lund-Malmoe Revised creatinine eGFR (2011)
- [`egfr_mdrd()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_mdrd.md) :
  MDRD 4-variable eGFR (IDMS-standardised)
- [`egfr_neonatal()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_neonatal.md)
  : Neonatal creatinine eGFR (2022)
- [`egfr_schwartz()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/egfr_schwartz.md)
  : Schwartz bedside paediatric eGFR (2009)
- [`gfr_bsa_adjust()`](https://mhovd.github.io/egfr/reference/gfr_bsa_adjust.md)
  : Normalise or de-normalise GFR using body surface area
